Use bottom trigger to scan location tag.
Use bottom trigger to scan location tag.
Scan Room Assets by squeezing the top trigger of the Zebra Sled and moving the reader next to all the assets in the location. You will hear beeping when an asset label has been read by the reader.

*It is worth noting that you do not have to use the top trigger for RFID reading. If preferred, you may keep scanning using bottom trigger for Barcode mode. Just start scanning barcodes on the labels.
When scanning is complete you will see assets on the screen change status to Green, Orange, Blue, or Pink. Each color represents the following:
: Item is expected in location but not found or scanned yet. You may choose to keep looking or just ignore them.
: Asset was expected after scanning location label and found when scanning.
: Item was found by scanning, but not expected in this location. You can choose to ignore or move this item to the current location by clicking on the item.
: Ignore these items. They are not your assets. They are likely RFID shipping labels, or other RFID items that are not your assets.
